newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices steady to higher.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were steady to higher on Tuesday with firmer markets reported in the Northeast and the Ohio Valley region, dealers said.
Reduced flour mill runtime was the key to a stronger Buffalo market, a Buffalo dealer said.
"There was some lost runtime this past weekend to the east of Buffalo" and renewed demand has created interest in this week's material, he said.
He added a few mills had some downtime in the Albany area.
Dealers said another factor was the decline in corn futures on the Chicago Board of Trade.
"I think all the midd buyers were happy to see corn futures on the board going down as far as the deferreds are concerned," another dealer said.
When the board went up, offerring prices for deferreds increased. "So I don't think there was much buying actually done on those increased prices," he said.
With corn prices lower, buyers were waiting for offers to come down, the dealer said.
